edges: Dr Schön rescued Lulu from a life on the streets and educated her.
Lulu forced Dr Schön to break off his engagement to Charlotte.
Lulu shot Dr Schön after he pressed a revolver into her hand.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Alwa promoted Lulu's new career as a dancer.
Lulu seduced Schwarz while having her portrait painted.
Lulu was killed by Jack the Ripper.
Dr Schön informed Schwarz about Lulu's dissolute past ahead of his marriage to Charlotte.
Countess Geschwitz aided Lulu in her escape from prison.
Dr Goll married Lulu off to himself.
